cases.title: Выбор, фильтр и массовые действия
cases.proof: Visible Select all scope differs from total batch scope. Opening is separate from selection.

cases.title: Карточки объектов
cases.proof: The same collection owner changes layout without changing selection semantics.

cases.title: Групповой выбор и раскрытие
cases.proof: Expansion does not change selection. Parent reflects only its children.

cases.title: Длинные имена
cases.proof: Full names wrap inside the row without displacing actions.

cases.title: Пустая библиотека
cases.proof: Acquisition differs from no filter results.

cases.title: Ошибка загрузки
cases.proof: Failure stays distinct from successful empty data. Recovery preserves logical focus.

cases.title: Один комментарий и встроенное редактирование
cases.proof: Single-selection comments preserve their own row/inline-composer pattern without introducing batch checkboxes.

cases.title: Один медиаресурс: источник и замена
cases.proof: Acquisition, replacement, and failure retain the accepted resource; this does not replace product import or media lifetime owners.
